title: Add nerv open full: the one-time sign-in landing on the full dashboard
goal: The owner reaches the full dashboard signed in without typing /full
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) runs the open command with full and expects the page /full, with and without --print; open and open dashboard keep / and /dashboard/
The headless test prints /full#code=… from the running service and /full serves the workspace app
Help and the guides that sent the owner to /full by hand name nerv open full

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one route choice, help, tests and two guides. Not a measurement.

privacy: No tokens or codes in Git; tests use a temporary data home.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
